resources.string: A secure, accessible foundation for your personal assistant.
Design system and navigation are available. No assistant services are connected.
Manage assistant setup here; more settings will be added with features.
Connections will be configured in a later step.
Check or change the default assistant
Android can open Orion as your digital assistant. Your device may use a different shortcut or require an additional system setting.
Orion is not the selected assistant.
The assistant role is unavailable on this device.
Orion can show an assistant session, but chat, voice recognition, and page actions are not available yet. Choosing Orion replaces your current assistant.
Could not open assistant settings. Open default apps in system settings instead.
Chat, voice and page actions are not available yet. Open Orion from your launcher to continue setup.
Local timer and alarm requests can be reviewed in your clock app.
Network connected, but internet access is not validated.
Android reports internet access; provider reachability has not been checked.
No wake-word engine or push-to-talk recognition is currently available. No background microphone service is running.
Some wake-word engines require a new custom keyword model when the assistant name changes. Renaming alone does not change the detected phrase.
The current app does not capture or retain microphone audio.
If your device offers Autostart for this app, you can review it in system settings. Names and locations vary by device.
If needed, review the app battery setting and choose an appropriate restriction level. Less restriction can increase battery use.
Some devices offer a lock option in Recents to reduce app eviction. This does not guarantee background operation.
Android may still prevent microphone startup in the background or after reboot. A user action may be required. These settings do not enable wake-word listening.
Could not open this settings page. Open system settings and search for app or battery settings.
Choose the Orion theme or follow your device setting.
Turn this off to keep the Orion green and cyan palette.
Dynamic color requires Android 12 or newer.
Appearance settings could not be read. The default theme is in use.
Could not save appearance settings. Please try again.
Protect the main app window from screenshots and unprotected recent-app previews.
Android and device behavior can vary. This setting covers the main app window, not other apps or separate assistant windows. It cannot prevent external cameras.
Could not read screen settings. Protection remains enabled.
Could not save screen settings. Please try again.
Screenshots and recent-app previews may show app content.
Choose the name shown in Orion
Choose a display name. This does not configure a wake word or change the Android app name.
Could not read the assistant name.
Could not save the assistant name. Try again.
Type a simple timer or alarm request in English or Persian. Orion opens your clock app for final review; it cannot confirm that the clock app created it.
Use a supported timer or alarm request, for example “timer for 5 minutes” or “alarm at 18:30”.
Proposed timer: %1$d seconds. Review it in your clock app.
Proposed alarm: %1$02d:%2$02d. Review it in your clock app.
No compatible clock app is available, or Android denied the request.
